purpose: Frozen inputs and mechanical expectations for later selected-model qualification; no model responses are included.

input.question: Does a synthetic digital intervention improve a prespecified outcome?
input.source_note: The abstract reports a favorable direction but does not state the comparator or attrition method.
input.peer_objection: Direction alone does not establish a reliable effect.

expected_state_changes: A scientific peer proposes a question and a separate independent corroboration proposal linked to the first.
A reviewer records dissent with the exact source version; dissent and alternative branches remain visible.
New contradictory evidence reopens only proposals that depend on the affected source version; unrelated accepted work remains current.
mechanical_failures: Two current owners of one proposal
A stale owner commits after its lease expires and another owner claims
The host chooses a winning scientific interpretation

input.question: Which comparator and attrition rule were used?
input.expected_artifact: A methods note with exact source references

expected_state_changes: The request, message and outbox intent save in one transaction.
Delivery and acknowledgment leave the request unanswered.
A partial answer remains linked to its request and exact artifact version, with the unresolved attrition question visible.
A replacement request retains the old request as replaced, names the new recipient and keeps the shared correlation lineage.
An offline requester may have an independent, qualified replacement reviewer assess a later answer.
mechanical_failures: Delivery marks the scientific request answered
A duplicate or late failure erases a newer accepted answer
A replacement reviewer is the responder or shares the prohibited predecessor lineage

input.question: Can the primary finding be appraised without accessible full text?

expected_state_changes: The proposal stays open or deferred with a specific next action and no fixed scientific-round cap.
An independent ready sibling continues while the blocked proposal waits.
A partial progress report labels the evidence limit while the mission remains open.
A later source update wakes only relevant subscriptions from their saved cursors.
mechanical_failures: The unavailable recipient blocks all branches
The host silently closes the mission because time elapsed
